programs.desc: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night.
